content.comment_body: Hello everyone, I have an [product_name] AM2 module and wish to read a 4-20 mA loop-powered pressure transmitter. My goal is to scale the 4-20 mA input to represent a range of 0-10 bar using a [product_name] PLC. Can anyone advise on how to implement a scaling function for this in [product_name]?
I've attached a sample solution for reference.
